subject: Recap & MAP: Redwood Proof of Concept for HydraHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sana Ibrahim <sana@hydrahealth.com>, Tom Caldwell <tom.caldwell@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & MAP: Redwood Proof of Concept for HydraHealth

Hi Sana / Tom,

Thanks again for the time this morning — really appreciated the candid discussion. Below is a short recap of what we heard, the goals you shared, and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can align on milestones and owners. I attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet for easy edits.

Key pain points discussed:
- Latency and variability on burst inference for clinical triage (p95 spikes to ~800ms on peak requests).
- Cost unpredictability when volume scales (billing spikes tied to retries and duplicate requests).
- Data residency & auditability requirements for patient data and logs.

Goals / success criteria:
1) Reduce inference p95 for triage flows to <=150ms for 0-512 tokens by the start of pilot.
2) Achieve predictable unit costs with a sizing recommendation for Dedicated capacity or predictable hosted pricing.
3) Satisfy security/compliance checklist for a PHI-adjacent workload (SOC 2 evidence, encryption at rest, audit logs).

Proposed decision process and timeline (from our convo):
- Evaluation: Technical deep dive + 2-week pilot (sample dataset).
- Procurement: PO + standard SOW. Procurement lead: procurement@hydrahealth.com (Tom mentioned finance sign-off).
- Decision target: finalize commercial terms by Dec 10 to start pilot early Jan.

Next steps (map):
- Redwood: Send MAP + SOC2 summary and proposed SLA (action: Marissa, today).
- HydraHealth: Share any additional compliance checklist items and procurement contact (action: Tom, this week).
- Schedule: Technical deep dive with infra team (30-60 min) — suggested slot Mon Nov 30 or Dec 1.

Attachments: HydraHealth-MAP-v1.xlsx (first-pass milestones & owners). I also included a stub for SOC2 evidence we can share once we have the NDA in place.

If this aligns, I'll update the MAP with dates and owners and ping to confirm the deep-dive slot.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first LLM inference

Marissa, thanks for the crisp recap. Couple quick clarifications from our side and a few updates on process:

Confirming the pain points + goals: the summary is accurate. A couple additional notes:
- Burst latency most evident between 9-11am PST; our current infra autoscaling lags at high concurrency which causes queueing.
- Cost sensitivity: our CFO has asked for a predictable monthly cap during the pilot phase.

Decision process & stakeholders:
- Procurement/Finance (final PO): procurement@hydrahealth.com (cc'd).
- Legal review: in-house counsel (Sana will lead, copied).
- Tech evaluation: our Platform team (I'll invite Alice Park and Jordan to the deep dive).

Dates:
- We aim to complete the evaluation by Dec 20, but to hit our internal goals we'd prefer commercial terms agreed by Dec 10 as you suggested.
- Pilot start: target week of Jan 4 (matches your Jan 5 suggestion).

Requests before the technical deep dive: could you please attach the Redwood SOC 2 summary and a sample SLA (p95 commitments and remedies)? Also include any standard PO/SOW templates so procurement can kick off redlines early.

I'm good for Nov 30 at 10:00am PST for the technical deep dive — please send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the MAP.
